product_metadata.title: EDEFISY Ice Cube Tray with Lid 6 Pack, Silicone Ice Cube Trays Molds for Freezer Easy Release, Blue
features: # [Safe Food-grade Materials]: The ice cube tray with lid are made of premium silicone(bottom) and PP material, Bpa-free. Our ice tray compare with all silicone ice cube tray, part of silicone ice cube tray is more stable, and it is not easy for water to spill out.

# [ Ice Cube Tray with lid]: 6 ice cube tray sets - Each ice tray makes 14 nice-sized cubes for a total of 84. Each ice tray is with individual lids. Size - each small ice cube tray: about 10"(L)*3.86"(W)*1.1"(H), each ice cube: about 1.5"(L)*0.87"(W)*1.1"(H)/ about 1oz.

# [Easy to One-Click Release]: Our ice cube tray with lid compare with the previous hard plastic ice tray, the bottom of the ice cube tray are made of food grade soft silicone material and has good flexibility. Each flat cube compartment is separate from others so you only need to open the lid and hold the back, and the ice cubes will pop out directly, which is very easy.

# [Stackable & Removable Lid Design]: Each covered ice cube tray comes with a practical lid, which allows to stack them in the freezer and save space. Also prevents ice from absorbing other food air in the freezer, so you can enjoy clear and clean ice cubes.

# [Easy to Use & Dishwasher Safe]: Fill the ice cube tray with water, cover the lid on, then freeze it into ice cube. And after using, you can clean this reusable ice cube tray with lid by hand or wash the ice cube tray in dishwasher. Air dry and stack the ice cube tray in the dry place.

# [Perfect Ice Cube Tray for DIY]: The ice cube is to cool cooling cocktails, whiskey, etc. Also it is good for other homemade drinks or various iced snacks, such as ice cream, fruit, jelly or baby food.
